name: Camping Oberstdorf
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Oberstdorf is located in the municipality of the same name in the federal state of Tirol. It offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents all year round. The sanitary buildings are equipped with showers, toilets, and washing machines. A kiosk on the grounds provides guests with basic foodstuffs. The surrounding mountain landscape is suitable for hiking and cycling tours. In winter, cross-country ski trails and ski areas are easily accessible. Pets are allowed on the site.
